creator: Alexander Terp
description: Found 2026-10-17 while fixing the same bug in MIP-7's maker watch (44134e74, which carries what each helper's maker was told across a handover as Handoff.Pane.maker_told). The stall watch (crates/muster-daemon/src/messages/stalls.rs) keeps its episodes in memory, so a member still holding a group up across a handover (a Muster upgrade) is announced again two minutes after the new daemon starts, though the notice says Muster says it once. The fix is likely the same shape: carry each told episode's first unread message in the handoff, and take it as told until the stall changes.
title: The stall watch tells a poster again after a daemon handover
